crossRefs.note: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations…
For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute…
You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod…

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
translations.bsb: So Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on the hilltop with the staff of God in my hand.”
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
translations.asv: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to-morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.
